title: BERT Open-Source Release
summary: Google AI announced the open-source release of BERT on November 2, 2018. The release included TensorFlow source code and pre-trained language representation models. The associated authors' paper describes BERT as Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers and as a method for pre-training deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text.
significance: A dated public open-source release milestone for BERT, recorded separately from the associated paper's earlier submission date.

verification.note: Google's first-party announcement is dated November 2, 2018 and explicitly states that BERT was open sourced, including TensorFlow source code and pre-trained language representation models. The authors' primary paper was first submitted October 11, 2018 and documents BERT's method and name. This candidate records the November 2 open-source-release milestone only; it does not substitute the October 11 paper-submission date for the release date and does not infer development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
